I’m going to uncover some miscellaneous changes first. MISCALLENOUS CHANGES Firerate Bug/ROF Bug - What even is the Firerate Bug? It is a bug that slows down the firerate of every tower and unit by 0.05s (0.025s for Level 4-5 Minigunner for some reason), prior to the Overhaul Update. This significantly affected fast-firing towers like the Minigunner, Ace Pilot and Turret. According to the wiki, the Firerate Bug has existed since the very release of the game. However, I just don’t think this was the case in Pre-MEGA, and early MEGA. It really only took notice around early 2020, but I have chosen to finally take the ROF Bug into account on these lists, since as mentioned, it started to take notice around this time and couldn't really be ignored anymore. This drops towers like the Minigunner (and Golden), Turret and Shredder on the ranking. Shield - This was a new mechanic that was added that enemies could have. This included the Templar, Summoner Boss and Fallen King. Basically, it visually made four shields appear around the enemy, which made the enemy limit most forms of damage to whatever the quoted number on the shields. Exceptions were: All forms of damage from units, including collision and ranged (for example, the Golden Mafia and Railgun Tank). Burn damage from the Pyromancer. Splash Damage. This addition significantly affected slow firing towers, especially Outlaw. However, for some reason, splash damage completely bypassed it, so there was an all time high demand for Rocketeer and Mortar for Fallen Mode. This really doesn’t move down Outlaw a placement on the ranking, as it is still the uncontested best late-game DPS tower with this addition. Rocketeer gets moved up from B tier to S tier, and Mortar moves up from B tier to high A tier. Also this meta change suddenly made Farm extremely vital and necessary for everything now, despite the other forms of cash generating still being the same. It goes from C tier to S tier. Goes down from high B tier to low B tier. Holiday Archer Arrows now do less damage as they pierce through enemies. Arrows now pierce through a limited number of enemies. This is quite a big nerf to the tower, making its early levels, Level 0-2 very weak. It's still solid in mid-game, still being able to do lots of DPS for its cost on its later levels, the massive range is still there, and max hits of 7-8 is a lot. Goes down from high A tier to low B tier. Military Base Level 5 - Railgun Tank Health: 800 -> 1,200 What the tower really needed was to make it worth upgrading past Level 2. It did gain a niche to “counter” shielded enemies as its ram damage did bypass the damage cap, but it is very inconsistent at doing so it will mostly just ram a different enemy. Does go a few placements up in C tier though. This is a double-edged sword as the Pursuit was way more consistent than the Ace Pilot, but fast enemies often just walked right past it. It also had the same placement limit, being 10. Anyways, as for the stats, it was quite cheap for the DPS it dealt, though the DPS was hampered quite a lot by the ROF bug though.
